fields.headline: Halyard Components is investigating unauthorized access to a company system
known: On Tuesday morning our security team detected unauthorized access to a file server.
We isolated the server within the hour and the plants are operating normally.
notKnown: We have not yet determined what information was accessed.
We do not know whether customer or employee information was affected.
beingDone: Outside forensic specialists are helping us investigate.
We have notified law enforcement and are preparing to notify anyone affected.
fields.nextUpdate: We will provide another update by 6:00 PM ET today.
fields.approvedBy: Approved for release: General Counsel and CEO, 3:05 PM ET

fields.headline: Halyard Components confirms customer order data was accessed
fields.body:
LAKESHORE, Ohio — Halyard Components, Inc. today confirmed that an unauthorized party accessed a file server containing customer order records between 2:14 AM and 6:40 AM ET on Tuesday.

The server held order numbers, company names and shipping addresses. It did not hold payment card numbers, bank details or Social Security numbers, according to the company's investigation to date.

Halyard isolated the server at 7:35 AM, engaged outside forensic specialists and notified law enforcement. The company will begin notifying affected customers on Thursday and will offer them a dedicated phone line.

A statement issued at 3:10 PM ET said the company did not yet know what had been accessed. The investigation has since determined the scope described above.
fields.quote: We are sorry this happened. Our customers trust us with their information, and we are working to earn that trust back.
fields.speakerName: Dana Whitfield, Vice President of Communications
fields.nextUpdate: The next update will be issued Thursday at 9:00 AM ET.
fields.approvedBy: Approved for release: General Counsel and CEO, 5:48 PM ET
